purpose: Stop repeat paid image regeneration for P2 cases that failed independent Visual QC twice. Require mechanism-level correction and a separate verified offline test before retry.

hold_release_requirements: Implement or demonstrate a source-locked composition or masked edit that cannot relocate original rack, bench, window, walls, floor and ceiling
Pass independent source/scene geometry QC with unchanged source SHA
Document new isolated trial asset version and cost cap in tests before re-enabling

hold_release_requirements: Implement safe-area/portrait-aware GBP overlay using a no-cost local preview, preserve current Golden Typography for all other articles
Verify woman's face and torso are not occluded in GBP 4:3 with actual tested R2 rendered assets before another image generation
